At θ = 4.0 °C, the thermistor resistance read from Fig. 7.2 is R_T = 3.2 kΩ [C1], and equating the potential divider ratios R / R_T = 2.4 / 1.8 directly yields R = (2.4 / 1.8) * 3.2 = 4.27 kΩ = 4.3 kΩ [A1]. (3) Leaf (c) [3 marks] verifies the output LED indicator design on Fig. 7.1: standard LED symbols with light emission arrows are required [B1]; two diodes must be connected in parallel between the output terminal V_OUT and 0 V (earth) with opposite polarities [M1]; and polarities must align with part (b) such that LED G points from V_OUT to earth (forward-biased when V_OUT = +5.0 V below 4.0 °C) and LED B points from earth to V_OUT (forward-biased when V_OUT = -5.0 V above 4.0 °C) [A1].
